g.text: Cohen's d: the difference measured in standard deviations

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

g.text: Individual measurements of two groups, d = (μ_B − μ_A)/σ. Bigger d → less overlap → easier to detect.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #222222

g.text: Choose d from the smallest difference that would matter in practice, not from an optimistic pilot study.

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

g.text: Even with heavy overlap of individuals, a big enough study can estimate the difference in MEANS precisely.
